title: Rancher console is reachable without authentication
description: The Rancher management interface is served without authentication. Rancher drives every downstream Kubernetes cluster it manages, including workload deployment and secret access.
remediation: Restrict Rancher to the administrative network, require SSO, and treat its bootstrap password as a first-boot secret only.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Rancher console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Rancher</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
